name: Smart Job Matching Engine
description: Matches available workers to jobs based on skills, location, and rate compatibility

nodes.code: const jobSkills = item.skillsNeeded || []; const workers = input[1]; return workers.filter(w => jobSkills.some(s => w.skills.includes(s)));
return item.sort((a, b) => { if (a.hourlyRate <= input.billRate * 0.7 && b.hourlyRate > input.billRate * 0.7) return -1; return a.hourlyRate - b.hourlyRate; });

nodes.subject: New Job Assignment - {{input.title}}

nodes.body: Job {{input.title}} could not be matched to available workers. Required skills: {{input.skillsNeeded.join(', ')}}
